verdict.rationale: Rootly documents generating API keys from Organization Settings, and Global API Keys are assigned an On-Call and Incident Response role at creation. That is a role-based scoping mechanism usable for an agent's credentials, but the evidence does not show how fine-grained those roles are or that keys can be narrowed to least privilege. missing for 10: documentation of custom or fine-grained permission scopes per key, non-global (team/user/read-only) key types, agent-specific credential guidance (e.g. for the MCP server), expiry/rotation controls, independent corroboration.
